channel.title: The Vicksburg Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Vicksburg Post (vicksburgpost.com)

item.title: There goes another hour
item.description: Daylight Saving Time arrives again this weekend, bringing longer evenings but one less hour in the day.

item.title: Kelley, Roma and Foster repeat as Run Thru History champs
item.description: Jack Kelley, Ron Roma and Terrie Foster all repeated as champions at the 47th annual Run Thru History, while Edwards resident Ashley Mason was a surprise winner after an eight-year absence from the race.

item.title: Photo Gallery: 47th annual Run Thru History
item.description: PHOTO GALLERY: Runners and walkers descended upon the Vicksburg National Military Park on Saturday for the 47th annual Run Thru History.

item.title: Warren County faces deadline for Kings Point Ferry plan
item.description: Warren County faces a court deadline to submit a plan to boost Kings Point Ferry service after a ruling that it must provide convenient access to Kings Point Island.

item.title: FERGUSON: You’re gonna have to serve somebody
item.description: A longtime minister reflects on calling, loss and the many ways we are meant to serve others.

item.title: Not-so-fast friends: Altman and Sessums bond at the back of the pack at Run Thru History
item.description: NOT-SO-FAST FRIENDS: Chuck Altman and Gary Sessums had never met before Saturday's Run Thru History, but got to know one another while setting a couple of race records — and finishing last.

item.title: Who's Hot: Malik Franklin
item.description: William Carey basketball player Malik Franklin, a Vicksburg High alum, was named the Southern States Athletic Conference Sixth Man of the Year and first-team all-conference.

item.title: Vicksburg soccer star Amari Johnson signs with East Mississippi CC
item.description: Amari Johnson scored 82 goals in her high school soccer career at Vicksburg High School, and is setting new goals now that she's signed with East Mississippi Community College.

item.title: VWSD leaders say audits on track as state targets late-filing districts
item.description: With state scrutiny on late audits, Vicksburg Warren was behind on filings but reports strong finances and will be caught up by March 31.

item.title: AROUND TOWN: Dr. LaTorre serves as Legislative Doctor for a day
item.description: Shadowing Dr. Latorre was Mason Nodurft, a third-year medical student at University of Mississippi Medical Center School of Medicine.
